raw.jobDescription:
Hi, I’m Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We’re looking for curious, driven Fullstack (Product) Engineers who want to own big things and delight our customers. You’ll design, build, and ship the core product experiences our customers rely on - while helping the team push boundaries on what great communication tools can do.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies - from scrappy startups to global brands - use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership
You own problems end to end. You move fast, act like an owner, and thrive in ambiguity. You've led complex projects before, whether officially or not, and you're ready to do it again.

Engineers with product taste

You think like a user, not just an engineer. You care about frontend polish, backend performance, and everything in between.

A healthy skepticism for “the way things are done”

You bring rigor and creativity. Best practices matter - but never more than forward motion.

What You’ll Do

  • Build fullstack features in Go, React, and Ember that power key customer workflows
  • Collaborate with others to turn ideas into shipped customer value
  • Share knowledge and raise the bar through sharing your progress publicly with short videos, thoughtful writing, and mentorship
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build
  • Help evolve our systems to scale with more customers, messages, and use cases
  • Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of experience building and scaling backend services and product-facing features
  • Fluency in TypeScript, React (or similar), and a statically typed backend language like Go
  • A strong care for frontend polish, backend performance, and the overall customer experience
  • Proficiency with APIs, relational databases, and writing testable, performant code
  • A bias for action over perfection, and pride in owning technical decisions

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $150,000 - $250,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.
  • Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let’s chat about what you’re looking for and how we work.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.
  • System Design Interview (60 mins) - Design a system end-to-end. We're looking for how you think, communicate tradeoffs, and drive through ambiguity.
  • Take-Home Assignment - Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you’d work on here.
  • Assignment Review Calls (2 x 60 mins) - Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you’d iterate.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. About the Role As our Principal AI Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of production AI systems that solve real business problems for our partners and shape how Able builds. You were a Technical Founder, Co-founder, or founding engineer at an AI company. You have the scar tissue of taking something to market and learning why product-market fit is hard. You will set the technical bar for AI at Able, working at the spec and acceptance layer of an AI-native engineering model, and play a key role in establishing Able as a leader in the AI space. What We’re Looking For Day-to-Day Responsibilities Technical Leadership: you will lead technical conversations, be hands-on in building applications or proofs of concepts, and establish AI/ML guidelines and standards for our partners, prospects, and across the organization. Entrepreneurship: you will spot market opportunities to match technology with business outcomes, bringing a builder's instinct for what will and won't land commercially. AI Thought Leadership and Innovation: you will drive Able's AI strategy forward by constantly exploring and implementing cutting-edge AI technologies, frameworks, and tools. Consulting/Business Development: you will work with partners and prospects to understand their business and conceive of opportunities to introduce technology (AI specifically) to improve performance. AI Enablement: you will provide coaching and mentorship, continuously enhancing our team's and partner teams AI capabilities through knowledge sharing and training on the latest technology and best practices. Required Skills & Experience 12+ years building AI/ML systems, with production experience shipping and operating them Fluency with the modern LLM stack: frontier models, RAG, vector databases, agentic frameworks, and the evals and guardrails that make them trustworthy in production You operate in the spec-and-harness model, leveraging agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.,) at the spec and acceptance layer Demonstrated experience leading large and complex projects Proven experience integrating ML and generative models with existing web and mobile applications Innate ability to effectively interact and inspire our partners and executive stakeholders on new AI ideas Demonstrated skill in connecting business challenges to the potential benefits of AI, and effectively communicating those opportunities to non-technical audiences Excellent English verbal and written communication Nice to Have Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong focus on AI and Machine Learning Experience with MCP, graph-based retrieval, or multimodal pipelines Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect: To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed. Payments made in USD. 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years. Wellness + Remote Stipend AI Voucher About Able Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you. Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

title: AI Software Engineer

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence. By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco . In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions that power and enhance our business products and operations. You’ll collaborate closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to build scalable, production-ready AI systems that deliver real business value. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically curious and creative problem-solver who is passionate about artificial intelligence, continuous learning, and delivering high-impact outcomes. Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to deliver integrated AI solutions. Analyze large datasets to extract insights and support data-driven decisions. Evaluate and select AI frameworks, tools, and technologies based on project needs. Monitor and optimize deployed models for performance, scalability, and reliability. Lead experimentation and prototyping efforts to test new ideas and algorithms. Participate in code reviews and mentor junior engineers. Communicate technical details and outcomes to both technical and non-technical audiences. Maintain a strong commitment to data quality, privacy, and ethical AI practices. Stay current with emerging AI research, frameworks, and methodologies. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field (Master’s preferred). Hands-on experience with LLMs, agents, and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or DSPy. Proficient in Python with familiarity in JavaScript or similar languages; knowledge of statically typed languages is a plus. Strong understanding of both relational (SQL) and non-relational databases. Experience deploying AI systems in production environments. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure); containerization experience is a bonus. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities. Strong communication skills in English—both written and verbal. Passion for innovation and using technology to create business value. Commitment to ethical AI development and continuous professional growth. Benefits At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution. We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor. Employment Terms United States Employment with Zone is “At-Will” , meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice. Non-US Jurisdictions This position is offered as a Fixed-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend (USA Only - 100% Remote)
description: About Us Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale. We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. Our Stack Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our TaskTiger scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented public API that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools. We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub and on The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like SocketShark , TaskTiger , LimitLion and ciso8601 . AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting. Our Teams When you apply, you’ll have an opportunity to highlight the team that appeals to you the most. We’ll do our best to honor this preference, but we'll also be evaluating skillset fit and the needs of the business. One thing to know up front: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close - this team is where you’ll start, but over time you’ll likely have the opportunity to work on many different projects. The work splits roughly like this. Pick the team that excites you most: Agents. Build Close’s agentic platform and customer-facing AI experiences. Voice Agents, Custom Agents, and Ask Chloe are already in flight. You’d work on the shared intelligence and orchestration layer that powers AI-driven processes across the product. That includes the ecosystem around our APIs and MCP surface, which enables external agents like Claude and ChatGPT to operate Close. This team is pushing deeper into applied AI, retrieval, and agent infrastructure more than ever before. Communications. Own the voice, SMS, and email infrastructure powering Close — Twilio, WebRTC, WebSockets, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, and more. You’ll help build our voice, messaging, and conversational AI agents while scaling real-time AI across calls, email, and calendar sync infrastructure. CRM. Build the structured context layer that humans and agents both depend on. We're rebuilding the data model so it flexes with real businesses, making the CRM agent-ready (retrieval, traversal, action coverage through MCP and our public API), and shipping the next generation of AI-native CRM features (AI Enrich, Autofill, AI Search). Operating on billions of Mongo documents with Elasticsearch underneath. Growth. Run the experiments and own the billing infrastructure that turn trials into paid customers. Stripe metered billing, AI credit top-ups, the activation and conversion funnel, and the team's biggest bet right now: agentic onboarding (an agent that walks new customers through setup, configuration, and first comms). Hypothesis-driven, metric-first. You Are A seasoned engineer. Python is our backbone, but perhaps you’ve worked across Go, Rust, or TypeScript. You pick the right tool for the problem rather than retreating to what you know. You’ve seen a variety of problems, can collaborate and self-direct. Building AI. You've shipped LLM-backed features for real users and have a POV on where they're trustworthy, where they fall over, and how to get them production-ready when customers bet revenue on the output. We use Pydantic, Temporal, LangFuse, and other modern AI infrastructure tooling to power our agent platform. Working with AI in your day-to-day. You use AI tools in your own workflow to ship faster, write tighter code, and reason about unfamiliar parts of the codebase. We fund the use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex and other best-in-class developer tools) and treat learning and experimentation as part of the work. A builder first. You’d rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship. Opinionated about API design for modern software. You've shipped internet-facing APIs and you think about who's on the other end - apps, agents, humans poking around in docs - and what each of them needs. Battle-tested. You've debugged incidents where latency budgets didn't hold, owned a system everyone else relied on, or carried a pager for something with real customer impact. Watch our culture video from our 2023 team retreat in Milan. Every year our entire team gathers in person to build connection, foster cross-functional collaboration, and have fun. In 2027, we're headed to Dusseldorf, Germany! Explore our product. Check out a demo ! Our Hiring Process We ask a few role-specific questions as part of our application process. These questions are designed to help us learn more about you from the start, so please answer each one thoughtfully. We see this as an opportunity to get to know you beyond your resume. We use AI tools daily at Close and expect candidates to do the same. In evaluating your application, we aim to get a sense for you - the way you think, how you communicate, the work you've done. raw.jobDescription:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Corporate Systems Engineering builds and operates the software platforms, integrations, and automations that power Smartsheet’s core business functions across Finance, Sales/GTM, and People & Culture. Our team owns mission-critical systems and workflows that enable how the company hires, sells, bills, pays, reports, and scales. We operate at the intersection of software engineering, enterprise platforms, and business-critical data, treating internal systems with the same rigor, reliability, and product mindset as customer-facing software.

Financial Systems Engineering owns and evolves the technology ecosystem that powers Smartsheet’s financial operations and monetization capabilities. The team is responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, and supporting technologies such as Avalara, along with the integrations, data, automation, and engineering capabilities that connect these platforms across the enterprise.

As Director, Finance Systems & ERP, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Smartsheet’s financial technology ecosystem and define the long-term technical strategy for how these platforms evolve. You will own the architecture, engineering maturity, technical health, and delivery of systems supporting core financial operations, procurement, planning, payments, billing, revenue processes, and emerging monetization models.

This is a strategic and highly visible technology leadership role. You will lead major transformation initiatives including ERP modernization, billing transformation, and the evolution toward usage-based and consumption-based monetization. You will represent Corporate Systems in executive steering committees and major transformation programs, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, and other technology leaders.

You will partner closely with Product Managers across Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to combine business and product strategy with a forward-looking technical strategy. You will be expected to challenge legacy architectures and operating models, identify opportunities to simplify and automate financial processes, and determine how modern software engineering, enterprise data, automation, and AI can improve how Finance technology operates.

You will report to the Senior Director of Corporate Systems and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leaders across the organization.

You Will:

  • Own the technical strategy and long-term architecture for Smartsheet’s financial systems ecosystem across ERP, procurement, financial planning, payments, billing, tax, revenue processes, integrations, data, automation, and AI
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Financial Systems Engineering organization responsible for platforms including NetSuite, Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, and associated technologies
  • Serve as the senior technology leader for NetSuite and ERP, ensuring the platform and surrounding architecture remain scalable, maintainable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the long-term needs of a complex SaaS business
  • Provide technology leadership for major Finance transformation programs, including ERP reimplementation and modernization, establishing architecture, engineering standards, technical governance, delivery practices, and long-term platform direction
  • Partner with Product Managers for Financial Systems and Billing & Monetization to translate product strategy and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture, investment decisions, and executable engineering plans
  • Shape the technology architecture required to support evolving SaaS monetization models, including subscription, multi-year, usage-based, consumption-based, and AI-related pricing and billing models
  • Partner across Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Corporate Systems to ensure pricing and packaging strategies can be represented reliably from quote and entitlement through provisioning, usage, billing, accounting, and revenue processes
  • Establish clear architectural boundaries and systems of record across CRM, product, billing, ERP, payments, tax, planning, and downstream data platforms, reducing ambiguity, duplication, and unnecessary coupling
  • Define the strategy for Finance systems data, including authoritative sources, data models, data contracts, quality, lineage, reconciliation, historical integrity, and reliable consumption by the enterprise data platform
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to integrate Financial Systems with the enterprise data lake and ensure Finance data is timely, trustworthy, well-defined, and usable for financial reporting, operational analytics, reconciliation, and AI
  • Drive stronger data quality and observability across Quote-to-Cash and Finance workflows, moving the organization from reactive reconciliation toward proactive detection and prevention of data integrity issues
  • Establish an AI strategy for Financial Systems Engineering, identifying practical opportunities to improve engineering productivity, financial operations, controls, testing, support, reconciliation, and employee experiences
  • Evaluate and introduce AI-assisted and agentic capabilities where appropriate, while ensuring financial integrity, security, auditability, human oversight, and appropriate controls for higher-risk processes
  • Develop a strategy for automated testing and quality engineering across the Finance technology stack, including regression testing, integration testing, data validation, reconciliation, and AI-assisted test generation and analysis
  • Establish modern engineering practices across enterprise platforms, including source control, peer review, CI/CD, environment management, automated testing, observability, documentation, release engineering, and operational readiness where supported by the underlying technologies
  • Determine appropriate boundaries between native SaaS configuration, platform extensibility, APIs, integrations, automation, and custom software, avoiding unnecessary customization while enabling capabilities the business requires
  • Partner with Integration Engineering to ensure critical Finance and Quote-to-Cash integrations use scalable patterns, explicit contracts, appropriate observability, resilient error handling, and well-defined operational ownership
  • Own the technical health and lifecycle of the Financial Systems portfolio, proactively addressing architectural debt, platform limitations, fragile integrations, unnecessary customization, manual processes, and recurring operational problems
  • Establish architecture reviews, technical standards, engineering metrics, platform health reviews, and other mechanisms that continuously improve the maturity of Financial Systems Engineering
  • Represent Financial Systems Engineering on executive steering committees, transformation governance forums, and major program reviews, clearly communicating architecture decisions, delivery status, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and tradeoffs
  • Provide technical leadership across implementation partners and strategic vendors, ensuring system integrators and software providers operate within Smartsheet’s architecture, engineering, security, and delivery expectations rather than allowing vendors to define the long-term architecture
  • Partner with Finance leadership, Accounting, FP&A, Procurement, Tax, Revenue, and other stakeholders to understand business strategy while maintaining clear technology ownership of architecture and engineering decisions
  • Balance delivery of major transformation programs with operational reliability, roadmap commitments, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, security, controls, and long-term engineering investments
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Product Engineering, Sales/GTM, Data, Security, AI & Automation, and Corporate Systems to ensure Financial Systems operate as part of a coherent enterprise architecture
  • Recruit, develop, and retain engineering talent with a combination of Finance platform expertise, software engineering capability, systems thinking, and curiosity about the future of financial technology

You Have:

  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across financial systems, enterprise application engineering, ERP, software engineering, systems architecture, or related technical disciplines
  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams, including experience managing managers, senior engineers, architects, or other technical leaders
  • Deep experience with NetSuite or comparable enterprise ERP platforms, with sufficient technical depth to lead architecture, challenge implementation decisions, and establish long-term platform strategy
  • Demonstrated experience leading a major ERP implementation, reimplementation, or transformation program from architecture and design through implementation, stabilization, and ongoing evolution
  • Strong understanding of financial business processes including record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, billing, payments, financial planning, accounting, and revenue-related workflows
  • Experience with financial platforms such as Coupa, Planful, Stripe, ZoneBilling, Metronome, Avalara, or comparable ERP, procurement, planning, payments, billing, tax, or monetization technologies
  • Experience with SaaS billing and monetization architectures, including subscription and usage-based or consumption-based business models
  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason across ERP, CRM, product, billing, payments, integrations, data platforms, APIs, automation, and financial controls as a connected architecture
  • Demonstrated experience defining technical strategy and architecture, rather than solely managing enterprise application delivery, configuration, implementation partners, or support
  • Experience designing or evolving enterprise data architecture, including systems of record, data models, interfaces, contracts, quality, reconciliation, governance, lineage, and downstream consumption
  • Experience partnering with enterprise Data Engineering or Analytics organizations and integrating operational systems with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar enterprise data technologies
  • Experience establishing modern engineering practices within enterprise application environments, including automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, release management, documentation, and operational readiness
  • Understanding of modern AI capabilities and the ability to identify practical applications of LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation while appropriately managing financial, security, and compliance risk
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, auditability, security, data integrity, and compliance considerations associated with business-critical financial platforms
  • Experience governing system integrators and technology vendors during large transformation programs, including the ability to challenge proposed architectures and hold partners accountable for engineering quality
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and senior business leaders to combine business strategy, product strategy, and technical strategy into coherent roadmaps and investment decisions
  • Ability to operate comfortably from executive steering committee discussions to detailed architecture reviews, translating effectively between business executives, Finance leaders, Product Managers, engineers, architects, and implementation partners
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge legacy processes and architectures constructively and lead organizations through significant technology and operating-model change
  • Excellent analytical, verbal, and written communication skills, with demonstrated executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technology decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

title: Architect
description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Architect on our Data Substrate team About the job Twilio runs on data, and the platform underneath it is entering a major shift. Open table formats, the convergence of lakes and warehouses, tightening privacy regulation, and AI workloads are all changing what a data platform has to do. We’re hiring an Architect to set our direction through that shift and to make sure the systems we build over the next 3-5 years are the right ones. You’ll own the technical strategy for our data platform, spanning storage, lake and lakehouse architecture, catalog and governance, and privacy-by-design. You’ll work across org boundaries, setting standards that dozens of teams build on and raising the technical bar for the engineers around you. Responsibilities In this role, you’ll: Own the architecture and multi-year technical strategy for the data platform, including the lake/lakehouse, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and governance, and keep them coherent as one platform rather than separate systems. Define where each engine fits (for example, ClickHouse versus open table formats on object storage) and the migration path between them. Make and document the major design decisions (ADRs, RFCs) on storage and open table formats, catalog strategy, compute engines, tenancy, data placement, and build-versus-adopt tradeoffs, with cost and performance at petabyte scale as explicit design constraints. Set the reference architectures for how our core storage and query engines (ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and lake engines) are deployed, tuned, scaled and operated as shared platforms, including capacity, cost, tenant isolation, and upgrade strategy. Define the reliability model for the platform: availability targets, failure domains, disaster recovery, observability, and incident response patterns that teams can adopt. Build privacy and compliance into the architecture, not onto it. Design deletion and right-to-erasure, retention, data residency, and PII classification so they work across the platform’s storage layers, backups, and derived datasets, including data that arrives from upstream streaming systems. Drive data governance: classification, catalog and metadata, lineage, access control integrated with our authentication and authorization systems, data contracts, quality and integrity standards, and a catalog teams actually use. Review designs and technical direction across the org, and act as the escalation point on hard distributed-systems and performance problems. Mentor principal and senior engineers, and grow architectural judgment across the org, not only within one squad. Partner with product, security, infrastructure and consuming teams to turn business needs into platform roadmaps, and say no or re-sequence when the tradeoffs require it. Track emerging data technologies (such as streaming-first architectures, federated query, and AI-ready data layers) and bring forward the ones worth adopting, with evidence from prototypes or benchmarks. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! Required: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 15+ years of experience in software development or a related field, with at least 8 years in an architecture or senior technical leadership role. Proven track record of architecting and delivering large-scale data platforms and setting their technical strategy, on cloud infrastructure such as AWS, deployed with Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm. Deep expertise in storage and compute for analytical data: columnar and open table formats, lake and lakehouse architecture, partitioning, indexing, query planning, and how the choices affect cost and performance at petabyte scale. Breadth across data storage and retrieval technologies, with hands-on depth in at least two of: analytical/OLAP engines (e.g., ClickHouse), search engines (e.g., ElasticSearch/OpenSearch), and lake or distributed processing engines (e.g., Spark, Trino, Flink). You can reason about when to use each, how they interoperate, and how to migrate between them. Working knowledge of streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) and how they interact with downstream storage. Practical experience designing data governance at scale: data classification, catalog and metadata management, lineage, and access control integrated with authentication and authorization systems. Practical experience implementing privacy and compliance requirements (deletion, retention, residency) across a large, heterogeneous data estate. Proficiency in one or more of Python, Java, and Go. Track record of writing and driving architecture decisions across multiple teams, and of changing the direction of an organization’s technical roadmap through influence rather than authority. Experience elevating engineering standards and mentoring senior engineers across teams. Demonstrated commitment to operational excellence: architecting for high availability, observability and incident response in distributed systems, and being credible when a platform is failing in production. Strong written and verbal communication, including making a complex tradeoff clear to engineers and to senior leadership. Desired: Experience operating one of these engines (e.g., ClickHouse, ElasticSearch) at scale, including replication, sharding, ingestion behavior, and multi-tenant isolation. Experience with catalog and metadata systems (e.g., Unity Catalog, Glue, Polaris, DataHub) and open table format catalog strategy. Experience with a platform migration across domains or ownership models, such as moving from central to domain-owned data. A track record of measurable cost optimization on large data platforms. Networking and network security knowledge. Location This role will be remote, and based in the United States. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location Compensation *Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only. The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $211,920 - $264,900. Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $224,400 - $280,500. Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $249,360 - $311,700. This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. raw.jobDescription:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments including procurement platforms (Ariba).

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI).

  • Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods, such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI.

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health Insurance

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Connectivity reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 💸 Pension Contributions

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// At Masabi, we're powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible, and seamless.

We're looking for Backend Developers to help build and evolve the services at the heart of our Justride platform. You'll work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that run at scale for transit agencies around the world, from fare and ticketing logic to the APIs and integrations that connect riders, operators and partners.

As part of a cross-functional team, you'll work closely with engineers, testers and product partners to take features from idea to production. What you build will shape the experience of riders every day.

Location_

// This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs that power core parts of the Justride platform

  • Contribute to the design of scalable, secure and resilient distributed systems

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver features from concept through to production

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards

  • Build and support integrations with internal services and third-party systems

  • Monitor and improve the performance, reliability and observability of the services you own

  • Contribute to technical discussions and help shape solutions and best practices

  • Take ownership of your work and support team outcomes

About You_

  • Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English

  • Solid commercial experience building backend systems in Java or Kotlin

  • Understanding of distributed systems and how to build for scale and reliability

  • Comfortable designing and working with REST APIs and service-based or event-driven architectures

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, ideally AWS

  • A thoughtful approach to code quality, testing and maintainability

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, happy to share knowledge and learn from others

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset

  • Able to explain technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues

We don't expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

What You'll Learn_

  • How a global fare payment platform works at scale, used by transit agencies and millions of riders

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, Kafka, AWS and infrastructure as code

  • How to deliver in a cross-functional, international team where developers help shape the technical direction

Our Stack_

  • Java/Kotlin (nice to have)

  • Event-driven architecture, RESTful APIs

  • AWS (DynamoDB, S3, SQS, EC2, ECS etc.)

  • Kafka

  • Terraform

  • Grafana

  • Gradle, Maven, Git

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

title: English to Belarusian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
description: About Welo Global Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com The Role We are seeking an experienced English into Belarusian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. Project Details - Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below) - Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month - Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract - Task type: Language Lead Support - Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support - Language pair: English into Belarusian What You Will Do -Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down. -Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes. -Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions from real alignment data. -Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager. -Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time. What You Will Own -The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance -The community’s shared understanding of quality -The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced -The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking Requirements - Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles - Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution - Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping - Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI) - Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting - Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements - Language: Native-level Belarusian and professional-level English - Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools Additional Key Information - Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work. - A background check is required as part of onboarding. - Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries. Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam. Why Join Us This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing learning, and access to established linguistic resources. If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global Job Reference: #LI-JC1 Compensation Additional Information

title: Software Engineer (Engineer III to Principal) - Formal Methods
description: Why us? Blockchain technology is enabling a rapidly-growing era of innovation for the digital world. It is crucial that blockchain code such as protocols and smart contracts are provably secure and correct. Once deployed, they are public and cannot be changed. Vulnerabilities and bugs in such programs regularly put millions of dollars at stake. This is where CertiK comes in. We are the leading blockchain security company. Our goal is to secure the cyber world by applying cutting edge techniques from academia to secure blockchain code. Come and join this ambitious mission as a research software engineer to work on automated analyses for provably secure and correct blockchain applications! What you will do You will design and develop tools that automatically ensure the correctness of smart contracts or identify security issues and bugs in smart contracts. We have software engineer positions available at all levels of seniority. Title and responsibilities will be commensurate with experience and background. As part of our multinational team of programming language experts, you will participate in the development of tools that rest upon techniques such as symbolic model checking, SAT/SMT solving, abstract interpretation, data flow analysis, and deductive verification. You will have the opportunity to work on all stages of tool development from idea generation to implementation and iterative improvements. Our team is highly supportive and collaborative with great opportunities to learn and grow. About you You have a background in programming language theory and automated reasoning and love to work on the forefront of applying results from theoretical computer science. You love to tackle computationally hard problems and have a proven track record of achieving results, where results are people using your tool to do their jobs. You are collaborative: you share ideas, love to brainstorm with peers, and give and receive feedback. You are comfortable with the unknown and understand that #startuplife means that you will be wearing multiple hats. Responsibilities Extend the scope and depth of our automated program verification tools and brainstorm, design, and implement new tools. raw.jobDescription:
Why us?

Blockchain technology is enabling a rapidly-growing era of innovation for the digital world. It is crucial that blockchain code such as protocols and smart contracts are provably secure and correct. Once deployed, they are public and cannot be changed. Vulnerabilities and bugs in such programs regularly put millions of dollars at stake. This is where CertiK comes in. We are the leading blockchain security company. Our goal is to secure the cyber world by applying cutting edge techniques from academia to secure blockchain code. Come and join this ambitious mission as a research software engineer to work on automated analyses for provably secure and correct blockchain applications!

What you will do

You will design and develop tools that automatically ensure the correctness of smart contracts or identify security issues and bugs in smart contracts. We have software engineer positions available at all levels of seniority. Title and responsibilities will be commensurate with experience and background.

As part of our multinational team of programming language experts, you will participate in the development of tools that rest upon techniques such as symbolic model checking, SAT/SMT solving, abstract interpretation, data flow analysis, and deductive verification. You will have the opportunity to work on all stages of tool development from idea generation to implementation and iterative improvements. Our team is highly supportive and collaborative with great opportunities to learn and grow.

About you

You have a background in programming language theory and automated reasoning and love to work on the forefront of applying results from theoretical computer science. You love to tackle computationally hard problems and have a proven track record of achieving results, where results are people using your tool to do their jobs. You are collaborative: you share ideas, love to brainstorm with peers, and give and receive feedback. You are comfortable with the unknown and understand that #startuplife means that you will be wearing multiple hats.

Responsibilities

  • Extend the scope and depth of our automated program verification tools and brainstorm, design, and implement new tools.
  • Adapt and improve algorithms for symbolic software model checking. Examples include bounded model checking (BMC), counterexample-guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR), and property directed reachability (IC3/PDR).
  • Build and extend translators from different input languages into intermediate representations, optimizing the generated models for automated analysis.
  • Identify new classes of security properties of smart contracts and formalize properties for use in our automated verification tools.
  • Closely collaborate with other software engineers in developing tools and set technical direction for solving problems in consultation with your team and management.
  • Work on all aspects of delivering working software that meets customer needs, including analysis, design, automated testing, operations, CI/CD, measuring results, incorporating customer feedback, and support.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related field or 5 years of equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 4 years of software development experience (includes internships, software developed during research, and open-source development).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with one or more of the following: model checking, formal verification, SAT/SMT solving (Z3, CVC4, Yices, MathSAT, SMTInterpol), abstract interpretation, or closely related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of fundamental computer science concepts such as data structures, algorithms, mathematical logic, and automata theory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in the broader field of automated reasoning.
  • Publication record in conferences like POPL, CAV, TACAS, FMCAD, FM, etc.
  • Experience in functional programming (OCaml or Haskell).
  • Strong and creative problem-solving skills; always willing to learn and embrace new technologies and to collaborate.

title: Senior Director, Agentic Engineering

Building or deploying AI-enabled and agentic systems, including model and tool orchestration, retrieval and context systems, evaluation frameworks, automation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls. Partnering effectively with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and business functions. Leading organizational change across distributed teams, including workflow redesign, enablement, communication, and adoption at scale. Establishing high standards for architecture, engineering quality, operational resilience, responsible AI, security, and cost management. Communicating complex technical and strategic concepts clearly to executives, technical leaders, and cross-functional teams. 15+ years of experience and Bachelor’s degree in CS or related field. We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! Be a changemaker You’ll enjoy: A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work A culture that celebrates performance The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard Career-defining opportunities Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled. Flexible paid time off and remote work policies Equity options, because this is your company too Contributions to your 401k . Your future matters Training opportunities to grow your skills and career Health and wellness credit so you feel your best Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook Enhanced parental leave to support growing families Fuel your growth. Find your people. At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role. At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skillset, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $300,000 to $360,000 USD , depending on the candidate’s location. Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, 401K plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within the United States, and refers to the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting, which may vary depending on the candidate’s actual location. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. raw.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

  • Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently.

  • Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling.

  • Designing targeted crawling pipelines that find high-value data sources, including audio, video, and multilingual content, and turn them into clean training-ready datasets.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably.

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and scaling web crawlers or scraping systems, ideally in support of machine learning training data.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed systems at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, queue-based architectures, or custom pipelines processing billions of documents).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate the quality, coverage, and compliance of crawled data, and to build the tooling to measure it.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

With SuperAnalyst, we are expanding that foundation into continuous, decision-ready execution: workflows that monitor change, update outputs, and surface what matters as situations evolve. Mobile is a critical part of that future because the moments that matter do not only happen when customers are sitting at a desktop.

Android is an important surface for that future because continuous, decision-ready workflows need to feel fast, secure, and reliable across phones, foldables, and managed enterprise environments.
